title: frangula californica var. tomentella
intro: Frangula californica var. tomentella, commonly known as California buckthorn, is a plant species used in herbal medicine. It has been traditionally used for its health benefits, including treating digestive issues such as constipation and diarrhea, due to its laxative properties, which make it an effective natural remedy for maintaining a healthy gastrointestinal system. The therapeutic actions of California buckthorn include stimulating bowel movements, reducing inflammation, and supporting the immune system. The bioactive constituents of this plant include anthraquinones, specifically aloe-emodin and rhein, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and laxative effects.
